tokenize_string: tokenize a string into a list of tokens with optional start and end tokens
build_vocab_from_sequences: build a vocabulary dictionary from a list of text sequences with minimum token count filtering
encode_tokens_to_indices: encode a list of string tokens into integer indices using a vocabulary mapping
decode_indices_to_tokens: decode a list of integer indices back into tokens or a delimited string
review_special_tokens: review the SPECIAL_TOKENS dictionary that defines NULL, START, END, and UNK token indices
